categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Guanggang Gases & Energy Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of industrial gases with a core focus on electronic bulk gases. Its product portfolio includes six major electronic bulk gases such as nitrogen, helium, oxygen, hydrogen, argon, and carbon dioxide, serving semiconductor manufacturing, display, fiber optics, and other high-tech industries, as well as general industrial gases for sectors like metallurgy, chemical, and machinery manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary core technologies including the 'Super-N' series ultra-high purity nitrogen production systems capable of producing ppb-level purity gases, advanced helium purification and storage technologies, digital remote control systems (ROC), data acquisition and analysis (ROM), and advanced process control (APC). It employs modular design, multi-stage distillation, vacuum cold box technology, and intelligent filling systems, emphasizing system-level gas production, storage, digital operation, and application technologies to ensure stable, high-purity gas supply.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in the semiconductor, integrated circuit manufacturing, semiconductor display, fiber optic communication, photovoltaic, and new energy sectors. The company also serves general industrial customers in metallurgy, chemical, machinery manufacturing, and food and medical industries. Its major clients include leading domestic and international semiconductor manufacturers, with a strong presence in electronic bulk gas supply and helium provision.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a focus on major industrial clusters including the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, Yangtze River Delta, Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, and central and western China. It has subsidiaries and production bases in Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Henan, Anhui, Hubei, Inner Mongolia, Shanghai, Zhejiang, and other provinces, as well as a presence in Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guanggang Gas operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the industrial gas supply chain, including gas production, purification, storage, and direct supply to end customers via onsite gas generation and retail gas supply. It also manages helium importation and global supply chain integration, positioning itself as a comprehensive service provider in the industrial gas ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with a '1+4+N' innovation platform focusing on system-level gas production, gas storage and transportation, digital operation, and gas application technologies. It invests heavily in R&D to overcome key technical bottlenecks, enhance product purity and stability, develop electronic specialty gases, and digitalize operations. Collaborations with universities and research institutes support talent development and technology transfer, aiming to drive domestic substitution and self-control in critical gas supply chains.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of industrial gases via two main sales models: onsite gas generation contracts (typically 15-year agreements with fixed and variable fees) for large-scale customers, and retail gas sales for smaller customers through self-built plants and logistics. The company also earns income from equipment sales and related services, with long-term contracts ensuring stable cash flows.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Guanggang Gas is a leading domestic electronic bulk gas service provider, competing against major foreign industrial gas companies such as Linde, Air Liquide, and Air Products. It holds a significant market share in China’s electronic bulk gas market, ranking first in new onsite gas generation projects for integrated circuits and semiconductor displays with a 41% capacity share. It is the largest domestic helium supplier, breaking foreign dominance in this strategic material.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.1 billion, a 14.6% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 247.96 million, a 22.42% decrease. Total assets reached RMB 7.94 billion, and shareholders’ equity was RMB 5.82 billion. The company maintains steady growth with ongoing capital investments in new projects and R&D, despite some profit margin pressure due to helium market fluctuations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guanggang Gas emphasizes its proprietary ultra-high purity gas production technologies, stable and reliable supply capabilities, and comprehensive onsite gas generation solutions tailored to the stringent requirements of semiconductor manufacturing. Its integrated supply chain, including direct helium importation and advanced digital operation systems, differentiates it from competitors by offering domestic self-control, cost-effective, and high-quality gas products, supporting China’s strategic semiconductor and high-tech industries.
